The Mandate

A defining CEO mandate for one of Europe's most active infrastructure investors. The incoming CEO will drive the next phase of platform growth across energy transition and digital infrastructure assets.

The Organization

European Infrastructure Group is a pan-European infrastructure investor and operator with €9.2B of AuM across 14 portfolio companies. The group has backing from three sovereign wealth funds and two of Europe's leading pension funds. Its portfolio spans regulated utilities, transport assets, and increasingly energy transition and digital infrastructure.

Search Context

The current CEO is stepping down after eight years having successfully taken the group from €3.1B to €9.2B AuM and completed the group's recent €1.4B capital raise. The board is seeking a successor who can extend the group's ambition into new geographies and asset classes while maintaining its reputation for governance excellence.

WHAT WE NEED

We are very picky. Only 1% of candidates gets chosen by our team members. It's because we serve the most demanding companies on the market.

✦ Deep knowledge of European infrastructure regulatory environments

✦ Prior experience in a GP-LP fund structure

✦ Board-level credibility with sovereign wealth fund or pension fund LPs

✦ Experience in DACH, Benelux, or Nordic markets

The Mandate

Series C energy SaaS company building the AI layer for European grid operators. The CTO will own engineering, product architecture, and the technical roadmap through the next growth phase and anticipated IPO.

The Organization

Lumix Energy Technologies is a London-headquartered SaaS company providing AI-driven grid intelligence software to distribution system operators across Europe. Founded in 2019, the company has grown to €38M ARR and 180 employees following a €95M Series C in 2025. Its platform is deployed in 9 countries and processes over 2 billion grid data points per day.

Search Context

The founding CTO is transitioning to a Chief Architect role to focus on deep research. The incoming CTO will take full engineering and platform ownership, manage a 90-person engineering organization, and lead Lumix through its IPO preparation in the 2027–2028 window.

The Mandate

One of Asia's fastest-growing financial services groups seeks a COO to own the full operating model across 11 markets as the business doubles headcount and enters three new geographies.

The Organization

Arctus Financial Group is a Singapore-headquartered financial services holding company with operating businesses in wealth management, lending, and digital payments across Southeast Asia. The group has 4,200 employees in 11 countries and has grown revenue from SGD 280M to SGD 890M over four years. It is backed by a consortium of sovereign wealth and strategic investors.

Search Context

Rapid expansion has created a need for an operationally exceptional COO who can bring structure, discipline, and scalability to a business moving at venture speed. The current COO is transitioning to an executive director role on the board as the group prepares for a potential IPO.
